nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Serum

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers generally report the serum does not increase oiliness or trigger breakouts and helps rebalance skin that has become dry from acne medication, though one reviewer whose skin had turned dry found it added needed moisture back.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers most often report strong, lasting relief from flaking and tightness, especially when layered under a moisturizer, but a minority found it left skin feeling dehydrated, sticky, or even burned.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several describe it as gentle, non-irritating and effective for chronic dryness, while multiple others report burning, allergic reactions around the eyes and lips, or that their sensitive skin simply could not tolerate it.
segments.mature: The few reviewers who mention their age or fine lines report visible smoothing and plumping alongside hydration.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention fine lines report they look diminished or improved with regular use; no dissent is recorded on this point.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe marked, lasting relief from dryness and flaking, often crediting it as effective as pricier alternatives; however, a notable minority report the opposite, saying it left their skin drier, sticky, or dehydrated rather than hydrated.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers report new redness or itchy red bumps appearing after use, with no reviewers specifically describing redness improving.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe burns, chemical-burn sensations, or skin taking over a week to heal after use, indicating a compromised barrier response in a subset of users, while others with sensitive or eczema-prone skin report no such reaction.
concerns.spots: One reviewer explicitly linked the product to new acne where they had never had it before, and another reported clogged pores and breakouts after a few days of use.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers are divided: some report no increase in breakouts and continued use alongside acne treatment without issue, while others report clogged pores and new breakouts within days.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the serum does not make their skin oilier and in some cases improves overall oil balance; no dissent is noted on this point.

aspects.libelle: Dropper hard to use, especially near empty

extraits.texte: I have sensitive, dry skin with eczema! I wanted to give this a try in hopes it would help my dry skin! Absolutely not. Not only do I feel like it made my skin drier but it also burned within a few minutes of application. I ended up having to wash this off.

Initially I started to use this product for three days straight, day and night and in the beginning I was very impressed of how well this hyaluronic acid worked on the skin! It is truly very hydrating I'll tell you that! But after the second and third day I noticed a change in my skin, and usually when I experience a new negative change in my skin I try to acknowledge all the new products that I begin to use and this was the only new product I included in my skin routine due to the fact that I was empty out of my old hyaluronic acid. I bought this one due to its great reviews but unfortunately the high percentage of hyaluronic acid clog my pores...which led to break outs!

I have been using this product for a few weeks now with the rest of the product line and it works really well. The product sinks into the skin nicely and doesn't feel heavy or sticky. I have oily skin and throughout the day this product doesn't seem to enhance that. I feel very hydrated after using this product. I also have acne prone skin and so far have no issues with it increasing breakout or causing them. highly recommend using this product with the rest of the skin care line.
This product is magic! I have extremely dry and sensitive skin and after using this my skin looks and feels amazing! Highly recommend! 10/10

extraits.titre: The answer to any dry skin!
extraits.texte: I was leery about trying any new products on my skin. I have hormonal acne and use peroxide washes and a nightly retinoid under direction of my dermatologist and sensitive skin. But the drying effect of my current regimen needed an answer and moisturizer wasn't enough for the winter months. I tried this product and reading other reviews and WOW! My skin is noticeably less dry and stays moisturized longer, no more flaking halfway thru the day. And its very lightweight and has caused no irritation to my sensitive skin. The amount of product for the price is great as well. This will be part of my regimen now!

I am 42, very very dry and very very sensitive skin. I struggle to find moisturizers that work and last. I use this under my daily moisturizer (Aveeno daily lotion). Now that I am getting a bit older I needed an extra boost, this has done the trick! I also use it at night under CeraV renewing night cream, they seem to clash and burns a bit but it doesn't seem to affect my skin.

I was liking how my skin felt until I woke up with a huge burn all over my chin. Took over a week to heal the horribly dry, cracked, and painful burn. Gave it 2 stars because it didn't burn the rest of my face so I might try again on just my cheeks and forehead but never again on my chin. Use with caution and in small amounts in case this happens to you.
